list_cached_repos: list cached repositories with filtering by size, type, access time, and refs, with sorting and limiting
list_cached_revisions: list cached revisions with filtering, sorting by accessed, modified, name, or size, and limiting results
remove_cached_repos: remove cached repositories or revisions by repo id, hf:// URI, or commit hash with dry-run support
prune_detached_revisions: prune detached unreferenced revisions from the local Hugging Face cache with dry-run support
verify_repo_checksums: verify checksums for a repo revision from cache or a local directory with fail-on-missing and fail-on-extra options
